patterns.note: Full-bleed hero section with oversized, overlapping brand typography that persists across scroll.
Content sections are presented as full-width, extremely rounded-corner cards, each featuring a blurred image and a small project label.
A highly decorative, custom-drawn serif font is used for the main brand title, contrasting with a clean, small uppercase sans-serif for project labels.
A minimalist palette of white and dark grey is accented by vibrant, blurred, abstract colors within the background and project imagery.
The main 'DADA PROJECTS' title remains fixed at the top, gradually fading to near transparency as the user scrolls down, revealing content underneath.
Background abstract elements exhibit a subtle parallax effect, moving at a slower rate than the foreground content.
Project showcase sections appear to slide or fade in from the bottom as they enter the viewport during scroll.

technique_notes: The main brand title is implemented as a sticky element that animates its opacity based on scroll depth, creating a ghosting effect over the content. This likely uses a scroll-triggered animation library.
Background visuals utilize a canvas-based animation or a parallax effect on images to create depth and movement as the user scrolls.
Content sections are revealed with a subtle entrance animation, such as a fade-up or slide-in, as they become visible in the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, decorative display text (~8x body) with small, uppercase sans-serif labels (~0.7x body).
design_tokens.radius: Pill-like rounded corners for all content cards, creating a soft, organic feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with significant vertical padding between full-width content cards and a spacious hero section.

standout: The site's distinctive use of an oversized, decorative brand title that subtly fades out during scroll, combined with full-bleed, extremely rounded content cards featuring blurred, abstract imagery, creates a unique blend of artistic expression and modern minimalism. The ghosting title effect is particularly memorable.
